collectors.titleDetails: (5 total Queries, 5 of them unique across 1 Connection)

queries.sql: SELECT SUM(dayDate) AS dayDate, SUM(Total) AS Total FROM ( SELECT SUM(dayDate) AS dayDate, SUM(melaVenue) AS Total FROM ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dayDate) AS dayDate, COUNT(DISTINCT melaVenue) AS melaVenue FROM tbl_mela_schedule WHERE part < '50' GROUP BY melaVenue ) a UNION SELECT SUM(dayDate) AS dayDate, 0 AS Total FROM ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dayDate) AS dayDate, COUNT(DISTINCT melaVenue) AS melaVenue FROM tbl_follow_up_sechedule WHERE part < '50' GROUP BY melaVenue ) b ) t

SELECT SUM(days) AS mela_days, SUM(melaVenue) AS total_mela_venues, SUM(melas) AS melas FROM ( SELECT 0 AS days, COUNT(DISTINCT melaVenue) AS melaVenue, COUNT(DISTINCT start_date, melaVenue) AS melas FROM mela_schedule WHERE phase = '2' UNION SELECT SUM(start_date) AS days, 0 AS melaVenue, 0 AS melas FROM ( SELECT DATEDIFF(end_date, start_date) + 1 AS start_date FROM mela_schedule WHERE phase = '2' ) g ) t

SELECT SUM(days) AS mela_days, SUM(melaVenue) AS total_mela_venues, SUM(melas) AS melas FROM ( SELECT 0 AS days, COUNT(DISTINCT melaVenue) AS melaVenue, COUNT(DISTINCT start_date, melaVenue) AS melas FROM mela_schedule WHERE phase = '3' AND start_date <= '2026-11-19' UNION SELECT SUM(start_date) AS days, 0 AS melaVenue, 0 AS melas FROM ( SELECT DATEDIFF(end_date, start_date) + 1 AS start_date FROM mela_schedule WHERE phase = '3' AND start_date <= '2026-11-19' GROUP BY start_date, melavenue ) g ) t

SELECT SUM(days) AS mela_days, SUM(melaVenue) AS total_mela_venues, SUM(melas) AS melas FROM ( SELECT 0 AS days, COUNT(DISTINCT location) AS melaVenue, COUNT(DISTINCT meladate, location) AS melas FROM december_mela_2022 WHERE mela_phase != '1' AND meladate <= '2026-11-19' UNION SELECT SUM(start_date) AS days, 0 AS melaVenue, 0 AS melas FROM ( SELECT DATEDIFF(meladate, meladate) + 1 AS start_date FROM december_mela_2022 WHERE mela_phase != '1' AND meladate <= '2026-11-19' GROUP BY meladate, location ) g ) t

SELECT SUM(days) AS mela_days, SUM(melaVenue) AS total_mela_venues, SUM(melas) AS melas FROM ( SELECT 0 AS days, COUNT(DISTINCT melaVenue) AS melaVenue, COUNT(DISTINCT start_date, melaVenue) AS melas FROM mela_phase_4_schedule_id WHERE PHASE = '4' UNION SELECT SUM(start_date) AS days, 0 AS melaVenue, 0 AS melas FROM ( SELECT DATEDIFF(end_date, start_date) + 1 AS start_date FROM mela_phase_4_schedule_id WHERE PHASE = '4' GROUP BY start_date, melavenue ) g ) t
